quedate.add_listing_photos.description: Upload to a listing of this key the photos chosen by photo_id from quedate.recent_photos of this conversation (1 to 20). Photos cannot be removed later.

quedate.add_my_listing_photos.description: Upload to a listing of the person you are talking to the photos they chose, by photo_id from quedate.recent_photos (1 to 20). A photo cannot be removed later.

quedate.booking_settings.description: How booking works in Quédate now ('immediate' or 'request') and Quédate's support WhatsApp.

quedate.create_host.description: Create a Quédate host for someone else (team use): name, email, phone, identity document (CI with V- or E-, PASAPORTE or RIF), date of birth, sex and nationality (VEN by default). If the email already belongs to a host of this key, returns it.

document_number.description: Para CI: V- (6 a 8 dígitos) o E- (6 a 9), p. ej. V-18234567.
document_number.title: Document Number

quedate.create_listing.description: Create a draft listing for a host of this key (team use), with property type and sector ids from the catalog. Not retried: Quédate does not delete.

quedate.create_my_listing.description: Create a draft listing for the person you are talking to, with property type and sector ids from quedate.listing_options and quedate.list_locations. Then add photos and send it to Quédate's review. Not retried: Quédate does not delete.

quedate.get_host.description: One host of this business's Quédate key: contact, verification status and listings.

quedate.get_listing.description: Public details of one Quédate stay by id or slug, with the dates that are not available. Never includes the host's contact data.

quedate.get_managed_listing.description: One listing of this business's Quédate key, with its status and host.

quedate.hide_listing.description: Hide a listing of this key (status hidden). Quédate does not delete listings.

quedate.hide_my_listing.description: Hide a listing of the person you are talking to (status hidden). Quédate does not delete listings.

quedate.host_verification_link.description: The identity verification link of a host of this key, to send to that person. Lasts 7 days.

quedate.list_hosts.description: All hosts this business's Quédate key created, 10 per page, with their verification status.

quedate.list_listings.description: All listings of this business's Quédate key, 10 per page, optionally of one host.

quedate.list_locations.description: Valid Quédate locations with their ids. No arguments: the states. With state: its cities. With state and city: its sectors. A listing needs the sector id.

quedate.listing_options.description: Options to create a Quédate listing: property types and amenities with their ids, rental types, booking modes, identity document types and today's BCV rate.

quedate.my_host.description: The Quédate host account of the person you are talking to: whether they are linked, their name, identity verification status and how many listings they have.

quedate.my_listings.description: The Quédate listings of the person you are talking to, with their status and price. Only theirs.

quedate.my_verification_link.description: The Quédate link the person you are talking to opens on their phone to verify their identity. It lasts 7 days; the same link is returned while it is valid.

quedate.quote_stay.description: Price a stay in a Quédate listing: total in USD and VES with the BCV rate. If the dates are taken or the guests exceed capacity, available=false with Quédate's message.

quedate.recent_photos.description: The photos the person you are talking to sent in this conversation in the last 24 hours (up to 20), each with a photo_id and when it was sent. Ask them which ones to use: an uploaded photo cannot be removed from Quédate.

quedate.register_me.description: Sign up the person you are talking to as a host on Quédate. Ask for first and last name, email, identity document (CI with V- or E-, PASAPORTE or RIF) and number, date of birth, sex and nationality (VEN by default). READ THE EMAIL BACK and pass email_confirmed=true only after they confirm it. Their phone is taken from this chat. If they are already linked, nothing is created.

document_number.description: Para CI: V- (6 a 8 dígitos) o E- (6 a 9), p. ej. V-18234567.
document_number.title: Document Number

email_confirmed.description: true solo si le leíste el correo a la persona y confirmó que es el suyo y está bien escrito.
email_confirmed.title: Email Confirmed

quedate.search_listings.description: Search Quédate's published stays by free text, city, state, dates (YYYY-MM-DD), guests, property type, price per night and rental type. Up to 10 results.

quedate.submit_listing.description: Send a listing of this key to Quédate's review (pending_approval). This tool never publishes.

quedate.submit_my_listing.description: Send a listing of the person you are talking to to Quédate's review (pending_approval). Quédate publishes it when approved; this tool never publishes.

quedate.upload_host_identity.description: Upload the identity document photo (required) and selfie (optional) of a host of this key, chosen by photo_id from quedate.recent_photos of this conversation.

quedate.upload_my_identity.description: Upload the photo of the identity document (required) and a selfie (optional) of the person you are talking to, chosen by photo_id from quedate.recent_photos after they tell you which ones. Quédate reviews them.
